title: A Bucketful of Joy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There is a well of joy so deep
That never will run dry;
Heavenly Father filled it up
Before the stars were high.

[Chorus]
So draw it up, and draw it up,
The bucket, full and bright;
And share the joy with everyone
Before you sleep tonight.

[Verse 2]
Remember all the good He's done
And feel your heart grow full;
The rope is in your hands tonight,
So pull, and gently pull.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Isaiah sang, "Oh, tell them all
The wonders He has done!"
For joy that's shared is joy that grows
And warms up everyone.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
The bucket rests beside the well
Until the morning sun;
And all the joy you drew today
Is safe now, little one.

[Chorus]
mood: Drawing-up music. A gentle rocking pull under the voice, hand over hand on a rope, each bar lifting a little further than the last, like a bucket rising out of cool dark water into the morning. A small harp carries the lift with a cello resting underneath, and a few bright plucked notes answer at the top of every line, the way water shakes off in the light. It opens outward as it goes — from one child quietly remembering to something worth telling someone — then settles back, still warm, for sleep.
